prompt:
Create a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail.

Left 60%: the text "I TESTED 5 STANDING DESKS" in a very heavy condensed sans, three stacked lines, white with a thick black outline and a subtle drop shadow, filling the height. Beneath it, smaller, in bright yellow: "one was a mistake".

Right 40%: a photorealistic standing desk at its highest position, slightly tilted toward the camera, with a red circle-and-slash icon drawn over one of its legs. Background: a clean studio wall in deep teal with a soft spotlight behind the desk.

High contrast, no other text, no faces, no logos. Everything must read at 320 pixels wide.
